description:
In handle_submit, after the hardcoded built-in check, call Dispatcher.get_command_by_invocation(state.extensions, cmd) before falling through to do_handle_submit. Run the handler in a Task.start (fire-and-forget, non-blocking) with a Context built from state. Any return value that is a string or list of strings gets appended to the transcript as a notification.

Upstream ref: interactive-mode.ts handleInput() command dispatch.
Affected file: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex
title: Route extension slash commands in handle_submit
